description: This Java class 'RequestedAcksValueValidator' is a final, immutable validator that checks if a CharSequence contains a JSON array of acknowledgement labels. It throws an exception if validation fails, ensuring that header values conform to expected acknowledgement label formats.

classes.name: RequestedAcksValueValidator
classes.description: A singleton final class that validates whether a given CharSequence is a JSON array of acknowledgement labels and throws an exception if validation fails.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the validator.

methods.name: validateValue
methods.description: Validates the provided CharSequence value by parsing it as a JSON array, and checks that each element is a valid acknowledgement label string.
